criticals.message: POLAR_STARTER_PRODUCT_ID cannot be read with POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN. Status: 403. Polar error: insufficient_scope. The request requires higher privileges than provided by the access token. Check that POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN is an Organization Access Token for the same Polar organization and includes products:read or products:write scope. If Polar returns insufficient_scope, create a new organization token with products:read and update .env.local.
